facts.fact: Julianne 头条：Ashton 与两大黄金单身汉共进午餐被目击。
facts.anchor: Skillett’s favorite daughter is back! Miss Ashton Tanner has been spotted out and about in town, enjoying lunch with Farrow County’s two most eligible bachelors, Jody Fisher and Brooks Hart.

facts.fact: Julianne 调侃：给其余人留点男人吧，欢迎回家。
facts.anchor: Save some man for the rest of us, Ashton—and welcome home!

facts.anchor: Also in Skillett, Talia is clearing out! Her famed end of season sale starts this week and runs through the end of the month
